 All GTA VI Rewards For GTA+ Members
 By Aaron Trueman November 18, 2026 
 GTA 6 
 Share 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Bluesky 
 Pinterest 
 Reddit 
 WhatsApp 
 Threads 
 Email 
 Copy Link 
 GTA+ members will get GTA VI exclusive content. Anyone who is currently signed up to the monthly subscription service will get a number of perks in-game. Whilst GTA+ has been predominantly a GTA Online-filled membership, it has now extended to the new game. We’ll be showing you everything included with GTA+ for Grand Theft Auto VI .
 For those unaware, GTA+ costs $7.99 / £6.99 / €7,99 a month. All of the bonuses found below will only be accessible while subscribed. If you end your GTA+ subscription, you’ll lose these benefits so you have to keep subscribed monthly.
 Venturas Blvd Elegy and Garage
 Credit: RockstarINTEL 
 Arrive in style with the elegantly appointed, redline-ready ’90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy, specially tuned and featuring an exclusive widebody design. Safely store your Elegy in this convenient single-car garage located in Crosstown, complete with weapon locker and ability to directly fence stolen items. This will be available to claim when you reach Chapter 3. 
 Transit Service Bonuses
 Credit: RockstarINTEL 
 Prefer the more scenic route? Get upgrades from Scooter Bros Premium vehicle care, premium membership on the RydeMe rideshare app, free scooter, bike, and Seashark rentals, plus free rides on Leonida public transportation.
 Store Discounts
 Credit: RockstarINTEL 
 Get a 10% discount from select businesses across Leonida, including weapons and clothes shops, hairdressers, tattooists, vehicle mod shops, and more.
 Increased Sell Value
 Credit: RockstarINTEL 
 Benefit from a 10% increase on all eligible owned vehicle sales.
 How To Disable GTA+ Boost In GTA VI
 If you wish to play the vanilla version of GTA VI without any of the GTA+ boosts, you can turn them off and keep your membership. To do this, open up the game’s pause menu, select the account tab, scroll down to GTA+ Boosts and toggle them off.
 Credit: RockstarINTEL 
 If you want to know what else is included in GTA+ for the rest of November, check out our full breakdown here . For those that pre-ordered GTA VI digitally, you will have gotten a free month of GTA+ so if you have not used that up yet now is a perfect time and here’s how to claim it .
 Will you be signing up to GTA+ for these? Let us know down in the comment section below.
 In other Grand Theft Auto VI news, the game has become the highest reviewed game of all time. Learn more here .
 You can pre-order your PS5 or XBOX copy with this link . Using the link to pre-order the game will help support this website as we’ll earn a small commission. Thank you!
